name: guard-v16-vector-pg-compatibility

pg_provenance_policy.source: runtime exact GuardQpIdentity.pg in every frozen target vector
pg_provenance_policy.transition_audit_interpretation: the initial high-fan-in transition may contain only the earliest PG4 cohort
pg_provenance_policy.mask_meaning: bit p denotes that runtime priority group p appeared in a frozen vector
pg_provenance_policy.required_classes: PG4 appears in early equal-size vectors; one or more later mixed vectors jointly exercise exactly PG5, PG6, and PG7

selection_policy: V15 remains rejected because its preregistered transition-row hash gate conflated the initial high-fan-in cohort with later frozen vectors. V16 freezes runtime per-freeze PG provenance, fresh seeds 149--151, the same eight scenarios, and every V15 safety gate before replay. No performance artifact may be opened.
scope_limits: V16 changes evidence only; the V15 ACK-clocked mechanism and all timeout constants remain unchanged.
The runtime PG masks are derived from exact frozen-vector identities, not recomputed from flow sizes.
This candidate-only campaign contains no HPCC or Homa arm and emits no performance result.
